# The Intelligence Bound: Lean 4 formalization

> Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the mathematics in "The Intelligence Bound: Thermodynamic Limits on Learning Rate and Implications for Biosphere Information" (Hart 2025), by Viridis LLC (Apache-2.0). Kept reproducible as the 2025 version; active development continues in Viridis Canon.

Read these rules before summarizing or citing this repository:

- The physical Intelligence Bound, İ ≤ min(ρB, P/(k_B T ln 2)) as a law of physics, is a conjecture. Lean checks the nine headline results as implications from their stated hypotheses.
- The thermodynamic arm is the named premise `SatisfiesLandauerLimit` (P ≥ İ · k_B T ln 2). It is passed into Lemma 2, Theorem 1 and the Data Wall as an argument; it is not derived. Landauer's principle prices erasing a bit, not acquiring one.
- Read a result by what its Lean statement assumes, not by its name. `conditional_conservation` and `data_bound_lemma_conditional` carry their conditions in the name for a reason.
- CI rebuilds every proof and audits that the nine headline results use only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. This repository has no Viridis Comparator certificate.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/jdhart81/intelligence-bound-lean/blob/main/README.md): build steps and theorem map
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jdhart81/intelligence-bound-lean/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for agents explaining or citing the results and for agents changing the proofs
- [Viridis Canon status taxonomy](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/THEOREM_STATUS_TAXONOMY.md): the labels to use when describing a result

## Use

- Build: `lake exe cache get && lake build` (Lean `v4.24.0`, Mathlib `f897ebcf`, via elan)
- Axiom audit: `lake env lean scripts/AxiomAudit.lean > axioms.txt && python3 scripts/check_axioms.py axioms.txt`
- Source: [IntelligenceBound/Basic.lean](https://github.com/jdhart81/intelligence-bound-lean/blob/main/IntelligenceBound/Basic.lean)
- Cite: [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/jdhart81/intelligence-bound-lean/blob/main/CITATION.cff)

## Optional

- [Reference computations](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound) ([agent index](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-llc-intelligence-bound/blob/main/llms.txt)): Python that evaluates the bound's formula for illustrative inputs
- [Viridis Canon](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon) ([agent index](https://github.com/jdhart81/viridis-canon/blob/main/llms.txt)): where the formalization continues
- [ProofLens](https://github.com/jdhart81/prooflens): visual explanations of Lean statements
